description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Application confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HiringDecision" name="Hiring decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyReview" name="Applicant review of company"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicantRating" name="Company rating of applicant"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Application confirmation and rating" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Potential job offer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HiringDecision" name="Hiring decision" sourceRef="Task_SendHiringDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHiringDecision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyReview" name="Applicant review of company" sourceRef="Task_SendCompanyReview" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCompanyReview" messageRef="Message_CompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicantRating" name="Company rating of applicant" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplicantRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Applicant" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplication" name="Write and send job application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interview" name="Negotiate a job interview?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview choice"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveHiringDecision" name="Receive hiring decision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Hired" name="Does the company want me to work for them?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Probation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RatingsSplit" name="Rate after probation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCompanyReview" name="Send company review" messageRef="Message_CompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApplicantRating" name="Receive company rating of applicant" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RatingsJoin" name="Both ratings completed"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostRatingsSplit" name="Continue after ratings"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneYear" name="One year passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVisible" name="Company review becomes visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Permanent" name="Does the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRating" name="Did I rate the company C or less?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ContinueOffers" name="Continue receiving offers without reporting"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Applicant" targetRef="Task_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Interview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interview" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewNegotiated = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewNegotiated = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveHiringDecision" targetRef="Gateway_Hired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Hired" targetRef="Task_Probation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hired = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Hired" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hired = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Gateway_RatingsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingsSplit" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Task_SendCompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingsSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A17" sourceRef="Task_SendCompanyReview" targetRef="Gateway_RatingsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A18" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApplicantRating" targetRef="Gateway_RatingsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A19" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PostRatingsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A20" sourceRef="Gateway_PostRatingsSplit" targetRef="Event_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A21" sourceRef="Event_OneYear" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A22" sourceRef="Gateway_PostRatingsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_Permanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A23" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Permanent" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRating">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobPermanent = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A24" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Permanent" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobPermanent = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A25" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="End_ContinueOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingAtMostC = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A26" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="End_Permanent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingAboveC = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company — Application and ratings" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmAndRate" name="Confirm receipt and rate application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DecideHiring" name="Decide whether applicant will work for the company"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendHiringDecision" name="Send hiring decision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyHired" name="Will the applicant work for the company?"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCompanyReview" name="Receive applicant review of company" messageRef="Message_CompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplicantRating" name="Send company rating of applicant" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CompanyNoHire" name="Applicant not hired"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CompanyRatingSent" name="Applicant rated"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmAndRate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAndRate" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_DecideHiring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_DecideHiring" targetRef="Task_SendHiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_SendHiringDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyHired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyHired" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCompanyReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hired = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyHired" targetRef="End_CompanyNoHire">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hired = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCompanyReview" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="End_CompanyRatingSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
